eyebrow: SOQL & Salesforce Data Management · Chapter One
subtitle: Lesson 3 · SOQL Fundamentals

code:
WHERE Amount >= 50000
  AND (StageName = 'Negotiation/Review'
       OR StageName = 'Proposal')
  AND NOT IsClosed = true
caption: =, !=, <, >, AND, OR, NOT — identical to T-SQL, same precedence.

code:
WHERE Email LIKE '%@acme.com'

WHERE StageName IN ('Closed Won',
  'Negotiation/Review', 'Proposal')
caption: % and _ wildcards, plus IN for list matching -- both unchanged from T-SQL.
